Before anything is installed, the Shield checks the package. Green: installs directly. Yellow: a warning, and you decide with the facts in front of you. Red: blocked, with no way around it.

For people who want a tool they can trust and use every day. Mods are welcome. Malware is not.

Local device: this phone, over its own wireless debugging. Network device: a TV or another phone on the same Wi-Fi. Each device gets its own ADB key, created at pairing, so one device never holds the key of another. Forgetting a device deletes its key; the device then asks for authorisation again.

APK, XAPK, APKM, APKS and ZIP with split APKs. An OBB file inside the package is copied to its place. The splits are filtered to match the target device (architecture, density, language). Open with and Share: a package opened from a file manager or shared to GoGo is checked like any other, and installed as soon as a device is connected and no install is running.

In this order:
1. Format and signature checks: the archive must be consistent, and signed with v2 or newer when the app needs it (an old v1-only signature is blocked).
2. Compromised keys: leaked system keys are blocked; the public Android debug key and modding tools are a warning.
3. Static deep scan: hidden code, aggressive adware and permission combinations. Whatever cannot be read is reported as incomplete, never as clean.
4. Trackers: known tracker SDKs are listed, for information only.
5. Native code: libraries must be real ELF files; injection or packer markers are a warning.
6. Online reputation: VirusTotal is asked with the file SHA-256 hash. 1 to 3 engines with light names (adware, riskware...) are Yellow; 4 or more engines, or a serious name (trojan, spyware, ransomware...), are Red. A verdict is kept for 48 hours.
7. Colour: the worst of the on-device and online results. A blocking finding is Red; a warning or a missing proof is Yellow; only a file proven clean is Green.

The keys are optional. Without them GoGo runs only the on-device steps 1 to 5. A new app can then never be Green: at most Yellow, with the text \"Not checked by online antivirus engines\", and you decide. No connection, a used-up quota or a rejected key are Yellow too, never Red. Red still always blocks. An update signed by the same developer as the installed app is still accepted.

When an update replaces an installed app, the old APK files are first pulled from the device and kept in the app storage. Backups lists them; Revert reinstalls the saved version in one tap. The setting \"Backup before update\" turns this off.

Only SHA-256 hashes leave the device, and only to the services whose key you added. A file is uploaded only if you confirm it, and it then becomes visible to that service. API keys are encrypted with the Android Keystore and never written to the log.

Appearance: theme and app icon. Security: Antivirus shield on or off, Security APIs (optional keys), Deep scan on or off. Installation: Home screen shortcut, Delete APK after install (off, on, automatic), Backup before update. Language and About.
